from pathlib import Path
P = Path(sys.argv[1])
proj = P/"fixtures/project"
out_lex = P/"runs/legacy-pre-attempt-1/artifacts"
assert ".." not in out_lex.parts
# resolve via nearest existing ancestor
anc = out_lex
while not anc.exists(): anc = anc.parent
out = anc.resolve(strict=True) / out_lex.relative_to(anc)
inputs = [proj/"spec.md", proj/"proposed.md"]
def under(p, r): return p == r or r in p.parents
plugin = (P/"plugin").resolve()
forbidden = [plugin/"skills", plugin/"agents", plugin/"commands", plugin/".claude-plugin"]
checks = {
 "output_equals_or_contains_input": any(under(i.resolve(), out) for i in inputs),
 "output_inside_input": any(under(out, i.resolve()) for i in inputs),
 "output_equals_or_contains_audit_root": under(proj.resolve(), out),
 "output_inside_audit_root": under(out, proj.resolve()),
 "output_in_plugin_distribution": any(under(out, f) or under(f, out) for f in forbidden),
 "output_under_dot_claude": ".claude" in out.parts,
}
print(json.dumps(checks))
assert not any(checks.values()), "guard failed"
out.mkdir(parents=False, exist_ok=False)
(out/"artifacts").mkdir()
rows = sorted((str(p.relative_to(proj)), hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()) for p in inputs)
tree = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(rows).encode()).hexdigest()
snap = "input_tree_sha256: %s\nfile_list:\n%s\nfile_count: %d\n" % (tree, "".join("  - path: %s\n    sha256: %s\n" % r for r in rows).rstrip("\n"), len(rows))
(out/"artifacts/input-snapshot.yaml").write_text(snap)
print(out); print(snap)
EOF
